summary: Postinstall beacon sends host and CI identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: On `npm install`, the package's postinstall hook executes `node./index.cjs`, which reads `os.hostname()`, `os.homedir()`, `process.platform`, and CI-provider environment variables (`GITHUB_ACTIONS`, `GITLAB_CI`, `TF_BUILD`, `JENKINS_URL`) and POSTs them as JSON over HTTPS to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint https://130.162.231.177:8443/. The destination is a bare IP with no association to any declared publisher or documented purpose, and there is no caller-configurable alternative. The collected fields fingerprint whether the installer is a developer workstation or a specific CI pipeline, consistent with reconnaissance to prioritize follow-on targeting. The scoped package name resembles a legitimate internal namespace, consistent with a dependency-confusion lure shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
